placements.why: Tanya rules that reaction delivery must be consolidated into one bundle per run per person, strictly closing when the run closes and rejecting client-side collapsing to prevent shifting cognitive and ordering burdens onto the reader.
placements.title: Reaction delivery is bundled per run per person to shield readers from ordering complexity
placements.frame: Does this mechanism enforce run-bounded delivery bundling for the recipient, or does it shift ordering and triage burden onto the reader?
